According to the rule given in the left picture below, we construct a numerical triangle with an integer number greater than 1 in each cell. Which of the numbers given in the answers cannot appear in the shaded cell?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the image gives the rule: if the two adjacent squares above are x and y respectively, then the corresponding square below them is filled with x×y. The right side of the image is a numerical triangle: the top row has 3 squares, the middle row has 2 squares, and each middle square is obtained by multiplying the two adjacent squares above it; at the very bottom there is one gray shaded square, obtained by multiplying the two adjacent squares in the middle row. Reasoning: Let the three squares in the top row from left to right be a, b, c, and each is an integer greater than 1. According to the rule in the figure, the two squares in the middle row are ab and bc respectively. The gray square is equal to the product of these two numbers, namely (ab)(bc)=ab^2c. Therefore, any number that can appear in the gray square must contain a square factor b^2 greater than 1. 154=2×7×11, has no square factor greater than 1, and is a square-factor-free number, so it cannot be written in the form ab^2c. Therefore 154 cannot appear in the shaded square.

method.method_draft: Read the image rule as: two adjacent upper cells containing x and y produce the lower cell x×y. For the three-cell triangle, label the top row a, b, c, each an integer greater than 1. Then the two middle cells must be ab and bc, and the shaded bottom cell must be (ab)(bc)=ab^2c. Therefore any possible shaded number must contain a square factor b^2 with b>1. Factor each candidate number from the answer choices; 154=2×7×11 is square-free, so it has no square divisor greater than 1 and cannot be written as ab^2c with a,b,c>1. Other candidates should be checked by finding explicit a,b,c if needed.

推理：设最上排三个格子从左到右为 a, b, c，且每个都是大于 1 的整数。根据图中规则，中间排两个格子分别是 ab 和 bc。灰色格子等于这两个数的乘积，即 (ab)(bc)=ab^2c。因此，任何能出现在灰色格子中的数都必须含有一个大于 1 的平方因子 b^2。154=2×7×11，没有任何大于 1 的平方因子，是平方因子自由数，所以不能写成 ab^2c 的形式。因此 154 不能出现在阴影格中。

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the center top cell in the three-cell triangle participates in both adjacent products, once to form the left middle cell and once to form the right middle cell. Let the center top entry be b>1. Regardless of the left and right top entries, every prime factor of b is contributed twice to the shaded cell because the shaded cell multiplies the two middle cells. Thus the shaded number must have at least one prime whose exponent is 2 or more. Now factor the answer options. For 154, the factorization is 2^1·7^1·11^1, so no prime has exponent at least 2. Hence 154 violates the repeated-center-factor invariant and cannot be the shaded value.
